title: Coco Gauff calls out online racism after China Open video review
summary: American tennis star Coco Gauff said Tuesday she faced an “insane” amount of online racist abuse after defeating Chinese teenager Sun Xinran in a match that included a video review.…

blocks.text: American tennis star Coco Gauff said Tuesday she faced an “insane” amount of online racist abuse after defeating Chinese teenager Sun Xinran in a match that included a video review. During Monday’s China Open match against 16-year-old Sun Xinran in Beijing, the former US Open champion requested a video review over flickering LED lights, prompting some boos from the crowd. “Hey everyone, you can dislike me or disagree about what happened without being racist,” Gauff wrote on X.
